summary.text: Mark Bromley is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran whose career includes work as an artist, licensed electrician and CEO, he previously ran for the Colorado House of Representatives in 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Mark Bromley was born in Denver and earned a high school diploma from Northglenn High School.
He attended Western Colorado University for undergraduate study and has served in the U.S. Navy.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Bromley said he had lived in Adams County for 55 years and served overseas in Japan aboard the USS Independence and USS Kitty Hawk.
Bromley ran for Colorado House of Representatives District 34 in 2020 as the Republican candidate and lost to incumbent Democrat Kyle Mullica, 38.8 percent to 56.2 percent.
He ran again for District 34 in 2024 as an unaffiliated candidate and received 2.3 percent of the vote in a race won by incumbent Democrat Jenny Willford.
In the 2024 survey, Bromley said his main goals were lowering the cost of living and housing, raising wages and protecting workers' stability of income, and supporting small businesses.
